title: Find the reference angle
text: $$tan(\theta)=\frac{y}{x}=\frac{-4}{3}$$. The reference angle is $$\arctan\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)$$, which is about $$0.927$$ radians.

title: Check the quadrant
text: The point $$(3,-4)$$ is in the fourth quadrant, so $$\theta=2\pi-\arctan\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)$$, which rounds to $$5.356$$.
